author: Georgi, 1775
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 10만 마리 이상 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 저수지, 강 등의 습지, 주변 농경지
summary: 국지적으로 흔한 겨울철새로, 대표적인 월동지에 큰 무리가 모이며 세계 월동 집단의 대부분이 한국에서 겨울을 난다. 낮에는 저수지나 강 같은 습지에서 쉬고, 밤이 되면 둘레의 농경지로 옮겨가 벼 낟알 등을 먹는다. 겨울에는 무리 짓는 성질이 강해 수만에서 수십만 마리가 큰 떼를 이룬다.

sexes.male: 얼굴에 노란색, 녹색, 검은색이 어우러진 독특한 무늬가 있고 부리 기부에서 정수리까지 검다. 앞가슴은 황갈색, 몸 옆은 푸른빛 회색이며, 가슴 옆에 흰 세로줄이 있고 어깨깃이 길게 늘어진다. 아래꼬리덮깃은 검다.
sexes.female: 전체가 갈색이고 부리 기부에 둥근 흰 점이 있으며, 목과 멱이 더 희다.

art.subject: Baikal Teal (Sibirionetta formosa), adult male in breeding plumage (worn through the Korean winter): crown and forehead black; face creamy yellow, split by a black stripe that drops from the eye to the black chin; a broad glossy green crescent from behind the eye to the nape, edged by a thin white line; breast pinkish-buff with small dark spots, ended by a vertical white bar at the side of the breast; flanks finely vermiculated blue-grey with a second vertical white bar at the rear; long drooping scapulars striped black, rufous and cream; black undertail coverts; dark grey bill; dark eye; grey legs.
art.pose: resting on open water within a large, tight flock, side view
art.scene: Korean winter: a large reservoir beside harvested rice fields, a vast flock on the water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: black crown, creamy yellow face divided by a black line from the eye to the chin, glossy green crescent edged white, spotted pinkish-buff breast with a vertical white bar, blue-grey flanks, drooping striped scapulars, white bar before the black undertail coverts
adult female, head detail in side profile: brown head with a darker crown, a sharply defined round white spot at the base of the bill, whitish throat and neck
art.build: Small dabbling duck, about 40cm: slightly larger than a Eurasian Teal, roughly two-thirds the length of a Mallard. Compact body, rather rounded head, short neck. Bill dark grey, slightly shorter than the head, narrow and straight. Legs short, grey. At rest the long drooping scapulars lie over the folded wing and the upper flanks. Tail short and pointed, held low on the water. Flies fast in dense flocks that form huge swirling clouds over reservoirs at dusk.
avoid: Do not paint a chestnut head with a green eye patch; that is Eurasian Teal.
Do not paint a crest or long tail feathers; the male's long feathers are the drooping scapulars on the back.
Do not paint an orange or yellow bill; the bill is dark grey.
Do not leave out the black line from the eye to the chin that splits the yellow face.
